aiResearchSummary.text: Reality Defender is researching machine-learning-based detection of fake videos by fusing image tiles and audio segments to classify content as real or fake. It develops data-driven audio deepfake detection and audio spoof detection using attention-based contrastive learning and visual representations of audio. It also explores generalized audio deepfake detection via style linguistics mismatch and uses common sense reasoning for deepfake detection, alongside bias discovery and mitigation for training data, covering video, audio, reasoning, and fairness.
